title: 「掃除のおばさんのくせに」 ― 和子さんを見下したママ友の末路
style: Photorealistic cinematic Japanese TV drama, shot on a 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, soft natural daylight, realistic skin texture, vertical 9:16 framing. All dialogue is spoken in natural Japanese.
location: A quiet residential street in Tokyo in the morning. An old but well-kept four-story beige building with a small flower bed of white and pink flowers at its entrance, and a small flower shop next door.

kazuko.name: 和子（ビルのオーナー・68歳）
kazuko.image_prompt: Photorealistic portrait of a 68-year-old Japanese woman, kind but dignified face, short neat gray-black bob, light makeup, beige knit cardigan over a cream blouse, thin gold reading glasses hanging on a fine chain around her neck. Upper body, facing camera, soft restaurant background, natural window light, 9:16 vertical.

rena.name: 麗奈（和子の嫁・38歳）
rena.image_prompt: Photorealistic portrait of a 38-year-old Japanese woman, fashionable and slightly haughty expression, long wavy brown hair, polished makeup, white silk blouse, designer handbag strap on shoulder. Upper body, facing camera, soft restaurant background, natural window light, 9:16 vertical.

misako.name: 美佐子（料理教室の主宰・45歳）
misako.image_prompt: Photorealistic portrait of a 45-year-old Japanese woman, glamorous and arrogant expression, sleek shoulder-length dark brown hair, heavy but elegant makeup, expensive cream-colored wool designer coat, pearl earrings, luxury handbag. Upper body, facing camera, Tokyo street background in soft morning light, 9:16 vertical.

kanri.name: 管理会社の社員（30歳・男性）
kanri.image_prompt: Photorealistic portrait of a 30-year-old Japanese man, polite and earnest face, short neat black hair, navy business suit and tie, holding a document folder. Upper body, facing camera, Tokyo street background, 9:16 vertical.

shots.prompt: Hook shot, close-up. In front of the building's flower bed, kazuko, wearing a plain gray apron over her cardigan, is watering flowers with a watering can. A few drops splash onto the cream coat of misako walking past. Misako stops, glares furiously and shouts in Japanese: 「掃除のおばさんのくせに！このコート、30万よ！」. Kazuko freezes, holding the watering can.
shots.captions: 掃除のおばさんの／くせに！／このコート／30万よ！

shots.prompt: Flashback, one week earlier, quiet early morning. Kazuko in a plain gray apron gently waters the white and pink flowers in front of the old building, smiling softly, touching a petal. A calm female Japanese narrator voice-over says: 「夫が遺したビル。この花壇の手入れが、和子さんの日課だった」. Kazuko herself does not speak.
shots.captions: 一週間前——／夫が遺したビル／この花壇の手入れが／和子さんの日課だった

shots.prompt: Misako, the owner of the cooking school on the second floor, walks out of the building entrance and passes kazuko, looking her up and down with contempt. She says coldly in Japanese: 「汚いおばさん、うろうろしないで」. Then, walking away, she secretly raises her smartphone and takes a photo of kazuko from behind, smirking. The phone screen is not visible.
shots.captions: 汚いおばさん／うろうろしないで

shots.prompt: Rena sits at her kitchen table at home, looking at her smartphone. Her expression changes from casual to shocked and then troubled as she recognizes someone in a photo. The phone screen faces away from the camera and is not visible. Nobody speaks; quiet room ambience.
shots.captions: ママ友グループに／届いた写真／「掃除のおばさん／感じ悪すぎ（笑）」／…お義母さん？

shots.prompt: Back to the present, same place as the first shot. Misako points at the wet spot on her coat and says loudly and mockingly in Japanese: 「弁償しなさいよ。あんたの給料何か月分？」. Passers-by and the young flower shop clerk next door stop and stare. Kazuko stays calm and silent.
shots.captions: 弁償しなさいよ／あんたの給料／何か月分？

shots.prompt: Rena, who has just arrived, pushes through the small crowd and stands beside kazuko, facing misako. She says firmly in Japanese: 「その人…私の義母です」.
Misako raises her eyebrows and laughs scornfully, covering her mouth with a gloved hand, and says in Japanese: 「へえ、姑が掃除のおばさん？かわいそうに」.
shots.captions: へえ／姑が掃除のおばさん？／かわいそうに

shots.prompt: A young man in a navy suit holding a document folder hurries over, slightly out of breath, bows deeply to kazuko and says in Japanese: 「オーナー！契約更新の書類です」. The crowd murmurs without words.
shots.captions: オーナー！／契約更新の書類です

shots.prompt: Close-up on misako's face turning pale with shock. Kazuko calmly unties and takes off her apron, folds it, and says quietly in Japanese: 「この建物の大家、私なの」.
shots.captions: この建物の大家／私なの

shots.prompt: Misako trembles, expecting to be evicted. Kazuko looks at her gently but firmly and says in Japanese: 「契約は続けます。ただし一週間、朝7時に水やりを手伝って」. Misako looks stunned.
shots.captions: 契約は続けます／ただし一週間／朝7時に／水やりを手伝って

shots.prompt: One week later, early morning at the same flower bed. Misako, now in plain casual clothes and no makeup, clumsily waters the flowers next to kazuko. Kazuko says softly in Japanese: 「この花はね、主人が最後に植えたの」. Misako's eyes fill with tears.
shots.captions: 一週間後——／この花はね／主人が最後に植えたの

shots.prompt: Evening, warm golden light. Kazuko and rena walk home side by side along the quiet street. Rena says shyly in Japanese: 「お義母さん、かっこよかったです」. Kazuko smiles and answers in Japanese: 「人は服じゃなく、その手で何をするかで決まるのよ」.
shots.captions: かっこよかったです／人は服じゃなく／その手で／何をするかで／決まるのよ

ending.question:
あなたなら、
許しますか？
ending.note: ※本内容は、実際のエピソードを基に再構成したものです。
